---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea to improve this project
title: "[Feature] <short summary>"
labels: [enhancement]
assignees: []
---

- Problem Statement
  - What problem does this feature solve? Be specific and describe the user impact.

- Proposed Solution
  - Describe the feature and how it would work. Include UI/UX notes if applicable.

- Alternatives Considered
  - List any alternative solutions or workarounds you've tried.

- Scope & Constraints
  - Any limitations, assumptions, or out of scope items.

- Additional Context
  - Links, diagrams, screenshots, or related issues/PRs.

- Acceptance Criteria
  - [ ] Clear, testable criteria for when this is "done".
